newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila water board approves privatisation deals.
newsitem.headline: Manila water board approves privatisation deals.

text.p: The board of the Metropolitan Water and Sewerage system (MWSS) of the Philippines on Thursday formally approved the grant of two 25-year contracts to operate services in the capital Manila, officials said.
Public Works Secretary Gregorio Vigilar told reporters the board formally approved granting the contracts soon after bids for the privatisation were opened.

A consortium comprising Ayala Corp, Bechtel Corp of the United States and United Utilities was awarded the contract for the east zone while a group including Lyonnaise des Eaux SA and Benpres Holdings Corp was approved to take over services in the west zone.

The Ayala-led consortium had posted the lowest bids for both zones, but was awarded only the east zone under rules aimed at preventing the same group winning both concessions. The Benpres-Lyonnaise group posted the second-lowest bid in the west zone.
Vigilar said the utility's operations would be handed over to the winning bidders in May.
